Here’s what I found after following your steps:

- Mobile data works great—I was able to load a webpage, and the speed test result was excellent.
- Data Saver is OFF, and background data isn’t restricted for the Messaging app.

- The Messaging app has permissions for storage and phone.

Despite all this, I still can’t send MMS messages—my messaging app says it cannot send them. What should I do next?

Thanks for the detailed checks—you're very close. One thing stands out: the Messaging app must have SMS permission specifically.

Please do this:
- Open Settings > Apps > Messaging > Permissions.
- Make sure BOTH “SMS” and “Storage” (or Photos/Media) are Allowed. If SMS isn’t allowed, enable it now.
- With Wi‑Fi OFF and Mobile Data + Data Roaming ON, try sending an MMS again.

If it still fails:
- Run the phone’s MMS diagnostic: can_send_mms() and tell me the result.

If SMS permission is granted and the diagnostic still fails, I’ll escalate you to a human MMS specialist to refresh your MMS provisioning.
